head: codex/5624-csdlc-prune-topology
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][prune] Resolve issue-local terminal worktree topology safely
body:
Closes #5624

Resolves literal dot, exact absolute, and repository-relative terminal worktree identities to one canonical checkout before guarded prune. Exact branch, live worktree topology, and cleanliness remain mandatory; malformed, missing, traversal, suffix-collision, wrong-checkout, wrong-branch, and dirty targets fail closed. Terminal receipt bytes are never rewritten.

Focused prune tests, command-level issue-local closeout proof, the complete C-SDLC v2 all-target suite, formatting, and strict Clippy pass on /Volumes/FastWork. The assigned exact-revision review completed with zero findings.
